values.note: Nightly $49.95 for 2 occupants, $5 per extra person per night (children 3 and under free). $44.95 for first responders and active/retired military or veterans arriving before 6 pm, with proof. Weekly $299; monthly from $550 plus electricity (3% card fee on monthly).

values.note: Booked online through the park's ResNexus page or by phone/text (912-224-6236); same-day and monthly stays by phone. Paid in full at booking. Check-in 1-6 pm only - no arrivals accepted after 6 pm; check-out noon. A specific site number isn't guaranteed.

booking.source: https://mcintoshlakervpark.com/reservations/ (ResNexus link; 'Call or text (912)-224-6236') + https://mcintoshlakervpark.com/camping-rates/ ('Check-in: After 1:00 PM and before 6:00 PM'; 'we are unable to accept reservations for parties arriving after 6 pm'; 'For same-day reservations, please call us directly'), read 2026-10-30

summary: Operator rates page: nightly $49.95 (the stored $44.95 low is a first-responder/military rate, so low -> 49.95); weekly $299, monthly from $550. Added hookups 30/50 + water + sewer at all sites, no showers, laundry, wifi, pull-throughs, ResNexus booking and the 1-6 pm check-in window. Good Sam false (directory) and military true confirmed by the operator's discounted rate. AWH note kept verbatim.
flags: Price gate: posted nightly rate $49.95 for 2 occupants - just under US$50 - but +$5 per person per night beyond two (children 3 and under free), so a party of 3+ pays $54.95+. No gateway within 40 km (Savannah 70 km); not Good Sam (directory gs false); family has not stayed. The $44.95 rate is only for first responders and military/veterans.

Phone: the field holds two numbers. The operator's rates and reservations pages give only (912) 224-6236 ('Call or Text'); the site footer still lists 912-832-6215 as well. Google Maps and the Good Sam directory both carry 912-224-6236 - suggest that alone.
Long-stay: weekly and monthly (from $550 plus electricity) rates are offered alongside a posted nightly rate and a ResNexus engine - passes test 2.
